text:
`requirements.md` has been updated with only the requested Gate 1 revisions:

1. **Rewrote `FR-13` (`packages/excalidraw/actions/actionStyles.ts`):** Specifies that within the existing arrow-to-arrow style-paste block (`newElement.type === "arrow" && isArrowElement(elementStylesToCopyFrom)`), pasting styles makes the target arrow's `arrowheadSize` match the source arrow's `arrowheadSize` in every case alongside `startArrowhead` and `endArrowhead` (setting the numeric value when the source has one, and leaving the target with `arrowheadSize === undefined` when the source has none, even if the target previously had an `arrowheadSize`), followed by re-routing elbow arrows via `updateElbowArrowRoute`.
2. **Appended `AC-8` after `AC-7` (keeping `AC-1`..`AC-7` numbering unchanged):** Requires a Vitest test in an allowlisted test file (`packages/excalidraw/actions/actionProperties.test.tsx`) verifying both arrow-to-arrow style-paste cases: copying from a source with `arrowheadSize: 1.5` onto a target with none sets `1.5`, and copying from a source with no `arrowheadSize` onto a target with `arrowheadSize: 0.5` leaves the target with `arrowheadSize === undefined`.
